p: seventh month was come: Called Tishri which had part of September and part of October.
son of Shealtiel: Meaning nephew, for he was the son of Pedaiah, 1Ch 3:19.
his bases: In the place where Solomon had placed it.
the continual burnt offering: That is, after the feast of tabernacles.
second month: Which contains part of April and part of May, for in the mean season they had provided for things needed for the work.
with his sons and his brethren: They gave them exhortations and encouraged every man forward in the work.

wept with a loud voice: Because they saw that it was not nearly as glorious as the temple Solomon had built, nonetheless Aggeus comforted them and prophesied that it would be more beautiful than the first, meaning the spiritual temple, they who are the members of Christ's body.
